lead.description: the set of observations that do not receive the experimental treatment

overview_sentence: A [control group](articles/control-group.qmd) is the set of observations that do not receive the experimental treatment.

self_checks.title: Small trial
self_checks.prompt: A drug group has 2 deaths among 10 patients and the control group has 5 deaths among 10. What is the risk difference, drug minus control?

self_checks.title: One more control
self_checks.prompt: The control group becomes 6 deaths among 11, and the drug risk stays 0.2. What is the control risk?
